weatherunderground_apikey_info: Optionally enter your Weather Underground PWS owner API key for station observations. Leave empty if you do not have one.
weatherunderground_apikey_info_1: Without an owner key, the adapter tries to extract a key from the Weather Underground website. Forecasts and regional weather products always use the website key.
weatherunderground_country_info: Enter the two-letter country code for the location you request data for.
weatherunderground_forecast_periods_txt: Text forecast (up to 6 days and nights)
weatherunderground_location_info: Enter a location name (e.g. "Berlin"), airport code (e.g. "ZRH") or coordinates (e.g. "47.3145359,8.4159812").
weatherunderground_station_info: Leave empty to select the nearest station for the specified location automatically. To choose another station, enter its station ID (e.g. "IAARGAUB5"). Find IDs on Wundermap: select a station and look for "Station ID".
weatherunderground_regionalCurrent: Regional current weather and air quality
weatherunderground_regionalCurrent_info: Optional; requires current PWS measurements. Adds up to 3 requests per run using the website key for regional weather, icons, visibility and air quality. Disabled by default; PWS measurements remain unchanged.
weatherunderground_iconSet_info: A–K all use the same v4 SVG icons with the current API. Select Custom for your own icons.
weatherunderground_current_info: Measured values from a private weather station (PWS), not a forecast. Hourly and daily forecasts have independent switches. When this is off, station observations are still fetched to obtain coordinates for forecasts.
